name: Annul Casus Belli
description: This will allow us to remove a Casus Belli they hold against us.

name: Call Appanage to War
description: We will call our Appanage to arms in our [war|e] against a [hostile|e] country.

name: Request Appanage Manpower
description: We will ask them to provide us with additional manpower for our forces.

name: Seize Court Resources
description: Seizing the resources of our Appanage's court will greatly damage our relationship with them. However, if they are powerful subject, the benefits may outweigh the dangers.

name: Ask for military access for war side
description: We will ask them to give us and our allies [military_access|e].

name: Ask for Money
description: We will ask them to help us out, with a small donation.

name: Use favors to call in to War
description: We will ask them to help us out by attacking our enemies.

name: Ask to reject Curia proposal
description: We will ask them to reject the current Curia proposal.

name: Ask to support Curia proposal
description: We will ask them to support the current Curia proposal.

name: Assassinate Character
description: Will it be a knife in the back? Or poison in the food? An accident while hunting? One thing is certain: this person will die.

name: Isolate from Allies
description: This will force them to break relations with another nation, and unable to regain that ally any time soon.

name: Break from Union
description: We will install a new ruler on their throne and force them out of their [union|e]

name: Bribe Voter
description: Spend [prestige|e] and offer [gold|e] to a member so they vote for the outcome we choose in the current law debate.

name: Request Divorce
description: This will ask them for permission for our [ruler|e] to divorce from the [spouse|e].

name: Excommunicate
description: This will [excommunicate|e] their [ruler|e].

name: Lift Excommunication
description: This will remove the [excommunication|e] and all of its associated penalties from their [ruler|e].

name: Request Lifting Excommunication
description: We will ask them to lift the [excommunication|e] from our ruler.

name: Place Interdict
description: This will place them under [ShowModifier('interdict')].

name: Lift Interdict
description: This will remove the $STATIC_MODIFIER_NAME_interdict$ and all of its associated penalties from them.

name: Request Lifting Interdict
description: We will ask them to lift the #Y Interdict#! from our ruler.

name: Install New Ruler
description: We will install a new ruler on their throne.

name: Change Court Language
description: We will demand that they adopt our [court_language|e]!

name: Change Policy
description: We will demand that they adopt our [policy|e]!

name: Demand Additional Tribute
description: We will demand that they give us a cash boost.

name: Demand Conversion to Islam
description: They do not follow $muslim_god_name$'s will. By demanding them to convert to [ShowReligionGroupName('muslim')] we can further increase our influence in their nation.

name: Demand Silver Tribute
description: The [ShowPolicyName('single_whip_policy')] policy now allows us to extract a higher toll of [ShowGoodsName('silver')] from our various subjects.

name: Demote from $celestial_governor$
description: They are not a worthy subject to carry the title of $celestial_governor$. We best demote their status within the [GetUniqueInternationalOrganization('middle_kingdom').GetName] lest they endanger our rule.

name: Enforce Culture
description: We will demand that they adopt [SCOPE.sCountry('actor').GetCulture.GetName] as their primary culture.

name: Enforce Religion
description: We will demand that they adopt [SCOPE.sCountry('actor').GetReligion.GetName].

name: Force to Change Court Language
description: We will make them use our [court_language|e].

name: Force Embargo
description: We will make them prevent another nation from using their market(s).

name: Form Closer Bonds
description: Form closer bonds with them and improve their opinion and trust with our [country|e]

name: Formalize Relations
description: Formalize relations with them and improve their opinion and trust with our [country|e]

name: Cede Location
description: We will give them part of our territory.

name: Cede Province
description: We will give them one of our provinces.

name: Transfer Location to other Subject
description: We will reorganise our subjects' lands.

name: Bestow Elector Status
description: We will make them an [elector|e] in the [GetUniqueInternationalOrganization('hre').GetName].

name: Rescind Elector Status
description: We will rescind their [elector|e] status in the [GetUniqueInternationalOrganization('hre').GetName].

name: Request Elector Status
description: We will request the status of an [elector|e] in the [GetUniqueInternationalOrganization('hre').GetName].

name: Bestow Free City Status
description: We will make them a [ShowSpecialStatusName('free_city')] in the [GetUniqueInternationalOrganization('hre').GetName].

name: Rescind Free City Status
description: We will rescind their [ShowSpecialStatusName('free_city')] status in the [GetUniqueInternationalOrganization('hre').GetName].

name: Request Free City Status
description: We will request the status of a [ShowSpecialStatusName('free_city')] in the [GetUniqueInternationalOrganization('hre').GetName].

name: Bestow $kingdom_title$
description: We will bestow a $kingdom_title$ to a [member|e] of the [GetUniqueInternationalOrganization('hre').GetName], allowing them to be elevated to the rank of a [ShowCountryRankName('rank_kingdom')].$kingdom_title_available_titles$

name: Request $kingdom_title$
description: We will request a $kingdom_title$ from the [hre_emperor|e], allowing us to be elevated to the rank of a [ShowCountryRankName('rank_kingdom')].

name: Ask for Ducal Rights
description: We will request our [country_rank|e] to be raised to [ShowCountryRankName('rank_duchy')].

name: Elevate County
description: We will elevate them to the title of a [ShowCountryRankName('rank_duchy')].

name: Request $county_privileges$
description: We will request privileges from the [hre_emperor|e] in the [GetUniqueInternationalOrganization('hre').GetName], allowing us to either receive the ability to enact [ShowGovernmentReformName('margraviate')] or [ShowGovernmentReformName('landgraviate')].

name: Grant $county_privileges$
description: We will grant privileges to a [member|e] in the [GetUniqueInternationalOrganization('hre').GetName], allowing them to either become a [ShowGovernmentReformName('margraviate')] or a [ShowGovernmentReformName('landgraviate')].

name: Enforce Landfriede
description:
We will enforce the Landfriede within the [GetUniqueInternationalOrganization('hre').GetName], ending any internal wars in the process.
#R We will be called into war against them if they decline!#!

name: Enforce Religious Unity
description: We will force them to change their [religion|e] to [GetUniqueInternationalOrganization('hre').MakeScope.GetVariable('hre_imperial_religion').GetReligion.GetName]

name: Demand Unlawful Territory
description: We will demand that they return Unlawful Territory within the [GetUniqueInternationalOrganization('hre').GetName] to its former owner. If they refuse, we will gain a [ShowCasusBelliName('cb_following_through_on_threat')] [casus_belli|e] against them.

name: Ask for Election Support
description: We will ask them to vote for us when electing a new Emperor.

name: Ask Elector to Vote for Candidate
description: We will ask them to vote for the chosen candidate when electing a new Emperor.

name: Bolster Imperial Army
description: We will request them to bolster our troops by having them join one of our current [wars|e].

name: Bestow Legatus Natus Status
description: We will make them a [ShowSpecialStatusName('legatus_natus')] in the [GetUniqueInternationalOrganization('hre').GetName].

name: Rescind Legatus Natus Status
description: Rescind [ShowSpecialStatusName('legatus_natus')] Status from [SCOPE.sCountry('recipient').GetName].

name: Request Legatus Natus Status
description: Request [ShowSpecialStatusName('legatus_natus')] Status from [SCOPE.sCountry('recipient').GetName].

name: Bestow Primas Germaniae Status
description: We will make them a [ShowSpecialStatusName('primas_germaniae')] in the [GetUniqueInternationalOrganization('hre').GetName].

name: Rescind Primas Germaniae Status
description: Rescind [ShowSpecialStatusName('primas_germaniae')] Status from [SCOPE.sCountry('recipient').GetName].

name: Request Primas Germaniae Status
description: Request [ShowSpecialStatusName('primas_germaniae')] Status from [SCOPE.sCountry('recipient').GetName].

name: Call Circle to War
description: Call upon a Circle Leader to bring their circle's military support to your current war.

name: Appoint Circle Leader
description: Use Imperial authority to appoint a leader for a circle that currently lacks one.

name: Petition the Imperial Diet
description: As a Circle Leader, petition the Imperial Diet to address a grievance or request.

name: Request Circle Privilege
description: Request a special privilege from the Emperor for your circle.

name: Challenge Circle Leadership
description: Our current Circle leaders have proven themselves to be unworthy of the position and the responsibility. We have the opportunity to put their power into question and undermine their authority, which can lead to their hold weaken even more, or to open opposition directly.

name: Appeal to the Emperor
description: Appeal to the Emperor to intervene in your circle's leadership dispute.

name: Request Financial Grant from Circle Diet
description: Request a new financial grant from our Circle Leader.

name: Request Military Infrastructure Expansion
description: Request a grant from the Circle Captain to use our existing reserves as additional workforce in the expansion of our infrastructure.

name: Elevate Country in Circle
description: Demand the elevation of our country within our Imperial Circle.

name: Ask to improve Cultural opinion
description: We will ask them to improve their [culture|e]'s opinion of ours.

name: Ask to improve Cultural opinion
description: We will ask them to improve their [culture|e]'s opinion of ours.

name: Influence Nation
description: We will use our diplomatic hegemony status to persuade them to think better of us, increasing their [opinion|e] of us and [trust|e] in us.

name: Intervene in Subject Civil War
description: We should intervene in this [civil_war|e] and sort it out once and for all.

name: Intervene in War
description: We should intervene in this [war|e] and sort it out once and for all.

name: Intervene in Union Civil War
description: We should intervene in this [civil_war|e] and sort it out once and for all.

name: Invite Artist
description: Invite the [artist|e] to live and work in our [country|e]

name: Invite Prince
description: We will invite one of their most important nobles to become our new ruler!

name: Invite Royal Family
description: We will invite one of our ruler's close relatives to our country.

name: Invite Settlers
description: Invite settlers to live and work in our [country|e]

name: Request League Sponsorship
description: Invite them to sponsor our League, granting them entry as a patron who contributes gold and manpower to us each month.

name: Revoke League Sponsorship
description: Revoke their sponsor status and remove them from the League.

name: Cancel League Sponsorship
description: Withdraw from our sponsor role and leave the League.

name: Violate Italian Sovereignty
description: Offer [gold|e] to an Italian state or League member to defect to our League, regardless of their current allegiance.

add.desc: actor wants access in recipient country

name: Bribe into League
description: Offer [gold|e] to an Italian state not yet in any League, enticing them to join ours.

add.desc: location number of recipient and subjects

name: Scout Enemy Holdings
description: Our spies will go deep into the enemy's territory, blending among their population, and reporting back to us with all the information they can find.

name: Sabotage Clan Buildings
description: We can send our spies to our enemy's territory, causing damage to their holdings by arson, poison, or any other available method.

name: Lend Unit to Ally
description: Grant temporary command of one of our army units to a war ally. The unit returns when we no longer share an active war.

name: Bestow [ShowSpecialStatusNameWithNoTooltip('lieutenant')] Status
description: We will make them a [ShowSpecialStatusName('lieutenant')] in the [GetUniqueInternationalOrganization('lordship_of_ireland').GetName].

name: Rescind [ShowSpecialStatusNameWithNoTooltip('lieutenant')] Status
description: We will rescind their [ShowSpecialStatusName('lieutenant')] status in the [GetUniqueInternationalOrganization('lordship_of_ireland').GetName].

name: Assert Regency
description: We will assert our [ruler|e] [actor.GetGovernment.GetRuler.GetName] as their [regent|e], a right that is ours due to our position in the [GetUniqueInternationalOrganization('lordship_of_ireland').GetName].

name: Enfeoff Regency
description: We will subjugate them as the personal [ShowSubjectTypeName('fiefdom')] of our [ruler|e] [actor.GetGovernment.GetRuler.GetName], a right that is ours due to our position in the [GetUniqueInternationalOrganization('lordship_of_ireland').GetName].

name: Surrender and Regrant
description: We will invite them to surrender their petty kingship and in return we will regrant them as new feudal titles under the safety of our legal system.

name: Merge Colonies
description: Order two of our colonies to unite into a single stronger colony.

name: Merge Tribes
description: Merge our tribe with theirs, unifying the two [countries|e] under [SCOPE.sCountry('actor').GetName].

name: Invite to Campaign Against [GetCountry('BYZ').GetNameWithNoTooltip]
description: Invite [recipient.GetName] to an upcoming campaign against the [GetCountry('BYZ').GetLongName].

name: Call Military Order to Crusade
description: We will call the sponsored Military Order to arms in our [war|e] against a [heathen|e] country.

name: Request Funds
description: We will ask them to help us out, with a moderate donation.

name: Request Soldiers
description: We will ask them to help us out, with additional manpower for our forces.

name: Move Subject's Capital
description: We will order our [subject|e] to relocate their [capital|e] to another [location|e].

name: Negotiate Succession Law
description: Their succession law is volatile and will lead to an end of the union. The ruling class must be convinced to adopt our own laws for a secure succession.

name: Ñusta Marriage
description:
We will propose one of our marriageable, female [characters|E] who is either part of the [ShowEstateTypeName('nobles_estate')] or [ShowEstateTypeName('clergy_estate')] for a marriage with the target country's [ruler|E].
When accepted, the character moves to the target country, and they gain an [opinion|E] boost of #G +100#!.

Unlike [royal_marriages|e], marrying a character with this diplomatic action will NOT create a diplomatic or royal bond between our two countries. The to-be married character does not have to be a member of our [dynasty|e].

name: Pay off Debt
description: We will pay off their [SCOPE.sCountry('recipient').GetEconomy.GetTotalDebt|2V]@gold! [debt|e].

name: Place Relative on Throne
description: We will place a [character|e] who is a relative to our [ruler|e] on their throne.

name: Press Sailors
description: We will take some of their sailors to serve in our navy.

name: Promote to $celestial_governor$
description: They are a worthy subject under our banner. We best reward their loyalty and cooperation by elevating their status within the [GetUniqueInternationalOrganization('middle_kingdom').GetName].

name: Propose Ruler
description: We will offer them a member of our own [dynasty|e] to become their new ruler.

name: Send Character to Prussian Crusade
description: We will send a [character|e] of our choice to the target country to participate in the #Y Prussian Crusade#!. The character will be under the control of the target country for #Y 5 years#!. During this time the character has a chance to increase their stats... or to die gloriously trying.

name: Invite to Prussian Crusade
description: We will invite their character to participate in the #Y Prussian Crusade#!. The character will be under our control for #Y 5 years#!. During this time the character has a chance to increase their stats... or to die gloriously trying.

name: Renegotiate Loan
description: This allows us to renegotiate the terms of a [loan|e] to get more [interest|e], at the expense of [favors|e] and [opinion|e].

name: Request Crown Character
description: Some members of the royal families are needed in our court. We can request them from the ruling seat of our ruler.

name: Request Loan
description: Take a loan from another [country|e]. [SCOPE.sCountry('actor').GetLongNameWithNoTooltip] will then be in [debt|e] to them.

name: Purchase Work of Art
description: Purchase a [work_of_art|e] from another [country|e]'s collection.

name: Demand Annexation
description: The Empire, long divided, must unite. They shall all bow to our rule!

name: Sabotage Reputation
description: This will give another nation a much worse opinion of them!

name: Upgrade to $maha_samanta$
description: We will elevate the status of our subject to a more loyal form.

name: Upgrade to $pradhana_maha_samanta$
description: We will elevate the status of our subject to a more loyal form.

name: Seize Territory
description: We will take some of their territory for ourselves.

name: Sell Corsica
description: Corsica has caused nothing but troubles for our state. The time has come to depart from this island once and for all.

name: Sell Icon
description: We will try to sell them a Religious Icon.

name: Sell Work of Art
description: Offer a [work_of_art|e] from our collection to another [country|e] in exchange for gold.

name: Share Maps
description: This will allow us to give them a map of an area we have [discovered|e] that they do not have.

name: Siphon Income
description: We will take part of their income directly to our coffers.

name: Start War in Colony
description: We order them to go to war with [SCOPE.sCountry('target').GetName]

name: Steal Maps
description: This will allow us to steal the map of an area they have [discovered|e] that we do not have.

name: Steal Technology
description: This will give us a fair bit of [research_progress|e] while actively weakening theirs.

name: Enforce Embargo Policy
description: We will demand that they apply all our active trade embargos.

name: Enforce Subject Peace
description: We will demand that they leave a war

name: Return Land
description: We will demand that they give back a [core|e] [province|e] to its rightful owner.

name: Surrender Civil War
description: All hope is lost, surrender this [civil_war|e] and let us end this pointless bloodshed.

name: Take Colonial Charter for Debt
description: This will ask them to cede a [colonial_charter|e] in exchange for us writing off a [loan|e] to them.

name: Take over Loan
description: This allows us to send a [diplomat|e] to a [country|e] and then become the [lender|e] of one of their [loans|e], forcing them to pay [interest|e] to us instead.

name: Take over Seniority
description: This allows us to surpass [SCOPE.sCountry('recipient').GetName]'s role of [ShowSpecialStatusName('senior_partner')] within the [SCOPE.sCountry('actor').GetDiplomacy.GetUnion.GetName].

name: $TRANSFER_OCCUPATION$s
description: We will transfer control of one of our occupied [locations|e] to [SCOPE.sCountry('recipient').GetName].

name: Transfer Subject
description: We will offer them the chance to take one of our subjects in exchange for gold

name: Enforce Union Peace
description: We will demand that they leave a war

name: $enforce_religion$
description: $enforce_religion_desc$

name: $enforce_culture$
description: $enforce_culture_desc$

name: Violate Sovereignty
description: We will make them give us [military_access|e] and [food_access|e].
